shared_elements: relief carving on a light beige/tan stone
horizontal band of repeated motifs across the upper portion
row of short parallel strokes / repeated vertical elements forming a border
animal or creature shown in profile
anthropomorphic element with arms/hands rendered against the body
composition organised into stacked horizontal registers
justification: Both are upright stone monoliths whose decoration is organised into stacked registers, each with a wide upper zone carrying a row of repeated motifs above a fringe of short parallel strokes, and profile creatures below — that register logic is the most specific correspondence. The manner of carving is otherwise wholly different: A is dense, deeply undercut, ornament-saturated high relief with no empty ground, whereas B is shallow, flat, sparse silhouette relief on broad blank surfaces, so the two read very differently as wholes.
